items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: "I was telling you about Rudolph (Bremwald?). Did you hear about him? He's fantastic. I saw a picture of him in that High Fidelity magazine."

ctx.x: we were much less enlightened about geriatrics than we are now. And I would certainly say that since most of my work involves theater people and musicians who are anywhere from 75 which eliminates you, but from 75 to 96 years old I have come to know a great deal, to learn a great deal, about older people.
I was telling you about Rudolph (Bremwald?). Did you hear about him? He's fantastic. I saw a picture of him in that High Fidelity magazine. He's ninety years old?
